directories.exclude.inside: "{text}" in exclude must be a name or path inside the working directory (do not start with /, do not include ..)
directories.exclude.item: {item} in exclude must be a non-empty string
directories.exclude.list: exclude must be a list of what to leave out ("target/", "sources/core/target/", ".png", and so on)
directories.folder.absolute: Write the folder starting with / or ~/
directories.folder.control: A folder cannot contain line breaks or control characters
directories.folder.path: folder is a folder on this machine (a string; null lets it go)
directories.named.none: There is no working directory "{name}" (there is none yet; one is made by adding {"type": "workdir", "name": "{name}"} to project_update's project_tree)
directories.parsers.key: The key "{key}" of parsers is an extension (.h) or a file's name (Makefile), with no / and no spaces around it
directories.parsers.language: The value {other} of "{key}" in parsers is a language's id (lower-case letters, digits, _ and -) or null (no language)
directories.parsers.object: parsers is an object {"<extension or file name>": "<language id>" | null}, or null (back to the defaults)
directories.tree.twice: The working directory {name} names the same working directory as another workdir entry
directories.tree.unknown: The directory ({id}) of the working directory {name} is not one of this project's working directories; left out, it is matched by name
